changeSet.author: kersting
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO tc_access_profile_permissions (profileid, permissionkey) SELECT profile.id, demo_permissions.permissionkey FROM tc_access_profiles profile CROSS JOIN ( SELECT 'device.appearance.view' AS permissionkey UNION ALL SELECT 'device.appearance.marker3d' UNION ALL SELECT 'device.appearance.marker-model' UNION ALL SELECT 'device.appearance.marker-color' ) demo_permissions WHERE profile.name = 'Demonstração' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tc_access_profile_permissions existing WHERE existing.profileid = profile.id AND existing.permissionkey = demo_permissions.permissionkey )
